title: skills/objectstack-ui: an eval case for the kanban lane statistic and card settings (owed by #36411 and #36857)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr

Follow-up of #36422 (PR #37063), from its contract review (comment on PR #37063, at head `7d7ca6db24`). PR #37063 teaches `kanban.summary`, `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields` in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, and its `Fixes #36422` closes the only card that carried the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` lines of #36411 and #36857. The "its evals exercise it" half of that debt is carried here.

## What is owed

1. **One eval case** in `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` that exercises a board's lane statistic (one of `count` / `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` with a `field`) and the two card settings. The dev of #36422 drafted one and dropped it because open PR #37043 appends case 24 to the same file at the same point.
2. **Two wording nits on the new note**, from the same review, cheap to fold into the same PR:
   - The note's "Known gap: over a lookup field or in a grouped view" has no subject; it can be read as the summary's own `field` being a lookup. The spec (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the `KanbanConfigSchema.summary` describe) says "lanes over a lookup field".
   - Nothing in the new lines says the three keys are optional, or that omitting `summary` keeps `summarizeField`'s sum (or shows no statistic without it), and the example writes both booleans with their non-default `false`.

## Done when

- A case in the evals file exercises the lane statistic and at least one card setting, and `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` passes.
- The note names "lanes over a lookup field" and says the keys are optional with their defaults.
- Token ratchet green with no ceiling raised unless paid down first in the same file (standing ruling, record 6513306068).

Blocked-by: #37043 (it appends case 24 to the same evals file)

## Grade

Suggested-grade: p3 · an eval and two wording nits on teaching that is already correct; nothing makes an author write refused metadata.
Suggested-domain: `domain:skills`
